cards.kicker: Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia · Race · 55 laps
cards.title: Everything that happened, in order
cards.text: 64 on-track passes, 72 pit stops, 3 cars that never finished, 2 safety cars, 1 virtual safety car.

cards.title: Lindblad starts P22. Where does he finish?
cards.text: 55 laps to make up ground from there.
cards.reveal: Somewhere in the points. The exact place comes at the flag.

cards.title: Lap 3: contact between Leclerc and Hulkenberg at Turn 9. What do you give?
cards.text: Race control has flagged it and it lands on your desk. If one driver is to blame, what does he get? Same call the stewards had to make.

outcomes.none: You let it go. Nobody loses a place at a desk, and the driver behind spends the rest of the race on the radio.
outcomes.5: Five seconds gets added at the next stop, or to the final time if there is no stop left. Usually one position, sometimes none.
outcomes.10: Ten seconds is a real punishment and it almost always costs track position, which is why teams argue so hard about it.

cards.reveal: The stewards took no further action.

cards.title: 73 position changes on the first lap of racing
cards.text: The first 2 laps were run behind the safety car and the standing start came at the end of them: 22 cars into the first corner on cold tyres and full tanks.
bullets: Stops made on the laps behind the safety car are part of that count
cards.note: Most of this is the pack sorting itself out. Some of it decides the race.

cards.title: 6 incidents looked at
cards.text: Every one of them logged by race control during the race.
bullets: Lap 3: Alonso, false start
1 ended in a penalty, 2 in no further action and 3 left for after the race

cards.title: 5 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.
bullets: 4 different drivers gained a place on this lap
cards.note: Soon after the start, with the field still sorting itself out.

cards.title: 7 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.

cards.note: Soon after the start, with the field still sorting itself out.

cards.title: 12 lap times deleted
cards.text: The white line is the track, and the lap simply stops counting if you leave it.
bullets: Bearman lost 3 that way, more than anybody
cards.note: Keep doing it and it turns into a penalty.

cards.title: Bottas is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 8 of 55, in a Cadillac.
bullets: P22 at the start of lap 7
Started P19
1 on-track pass before it happened
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.kicker: Your call on the pit wall
cards.title: Safety car with 46 laps left. You are leading. Box or stay out?
cards.text: The pack is about to bunch up behind you and a stop costs far less than usual, except that everybody behind can copy you and anyone who stays out may come out ahead.

choices.label: Box for fresh tyres
choices.sub: Grip for the restart, at the risk of track position

choices.label: Stay out and defend
choices.sub: Keep the lead on older tyres

outcomes.box: New rubber under a safety car is close to free. If the cars behind follow you in, the order holds. If they stay out, your gap has to cover the stop.
outcomes.stay: You keep the lead and restart on older tyres, with a queue of fresher cars in your mirrors and no gap to hide in.

cards.title: Every gap on track, erased
cards.text: The field bunches up behind the safety car, and whatever anybody had built is gone.
bullets: Antonelli was leading when it came out
He took a stop under it, and so did Verstappen, Russell, Hadjar and 15 others
Neutralised until lap 12
cards.note: This early, nobody had a lead to lose. What it did do was hand a cheap stop to whoever was ready to take one.

cards.title: 5 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.
bullets: 5 different drivers gained a place on this lap
cards.note: Every one of them on track, with no stops around it.

cards.title: Yellow flags out 10 times
cards.text: Race control waves a yellow for anything on or near the track that should not be there.
bullets: A yellow means slow down and do not overtake in that part of the track
Track sectors 3 and 4 saw 6 calls each, more than anywhere else

cards.title: Track steady around 34°C all race
cards.text: Track temperature changes how much grip the tyres find and how fast they wear. No rain was recorded during the race.

cards.title: Leclerc: 14 passes
cards.text: More than anybody else out there, in a Ferrari.
bullets: P4 on the grid, P4 at the flag
cards.note: Only moves made on track count, with the car ahead at racing speed.

cards.title: 1 penalty handed out
cards.text: Given by the stewards during the race.
bullets: Bortoleto: a 10s penalty for causing a collision
cards.note: A time penalty is served at the next stop, or added to the final time when there is no stop left.

cards.title: Piastri: 9 laps within a second of the car ahead
cards.text: The longest unbroken run like it in the race, from lap 16 to lap 24, at racing speed.
bullets: 3 other drivers had a run of five laps or more like it
cards.note: Following closely costs the car downforce and cooks the front tyres, so sitting there is harder than it looks.

cards.title: Colapinto hit 347 km/h
cards.text: The trap reads one fixed point on the lap, so a car can go faster elsewhere. And the fastest car in a straight line is often not the fastest car over a lap.
bullets: Colapinto did it in an Alpine
cards.note: Top speed says as much about wing level, and about sitting in somebody's tow, as it does about the engine.

cards.title: 72 stops, and the busiest lap saw 18 of them
cards.text: Once one car stops, the cars around it have to answer.
bullets: Busiest single lap was 9, with 18 cars in under the safety car
Shortest time in the pit lane: Antonelli, 27.2s
cards.note: Pit lane time runs from the entry line to the exit line, stop included.

cards.title: Who has the fastest lap on the board at the flag?
cards.text: It usually lands late, when the car is light and the track has rubber all over it.
cards.reveal: Verstappen on lap 55, 1:38.220, in a Red Bull.

cards.title: Perez stopped 6 times
cards.text: Six stops when most of the field made 3.
bullets: In on laps 1, 9, 18, 21, 39 and 44
2 of them under a safety car or VSC

cards.title: Verstappen had the quickest median racing lap
cards.text: No lap 1, no laps in or out of the pits, nothing behind the safety car or the VSC, and the slow outliers trimmed. It does not always match the result.

cards.title: Albon is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 42 of 55, in a Williams.
bullets: P19 at the start of lap 41
Started P18
1 on-track pass before it happened

cards.title: Everybody slows down, nobody bunches up
cards.text: Every car is held to a delta time exactly where it is. The gaps freeze instead of vanishing, which is the whole difference from a real safety car.
bullets: Verstappen was leading when it was called
Colapinto, Sainz, Verstappen and 7 others stopped under it
A safety car took over on lap 45
cards.note: A stop under a VSC costs less than one at racing speed, because everybody else is going slowly too. Cheaper, not free: the leader keeps his gap and the queue behind him keeps its shape.

cards.title: One of these three does not see the chequered flag. Who?
cards.text: Nothing on the timing screens says it is coming.

cards.title: Every gap on track, erased
cards.text: The field bunches up behind the safety car, and whatever anybody had built is gone.
bullets: Verstappen was leading when it came out
He stayed out while Bortoleto, Perez, Piastri and 5 others stopped under it
Neutralised until lap 51
cards.note: A lead built over a long run was worth nothing at the restart, and whoever had fresher tyres underneath him suddenly had a race again.

cards.title: Bortoleto went the other way: 8 places lost
cards.text: Qualifying promised one thing and the race delivered another.
bullets: P10 on the grid, P18 at the flag
5 stops when most of the field made 3
Qualifying rewards whoever can put one lap together. A race asks for 55 of them

cards.title: Russell is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 50 of 55, in a Mercedes.
bullets: P3 at the start of lap 49
Started P7

cards.title: Russell was P3 a lap before his race ended on lap 50. Where does he finish if it had not?
cards.text: Nobody can answer this one for certain. You have his own lap times to go on and nothing else.
cards.reveal: Our read from his own lap times, not a fact. He was lapping 0.72s a lap slower than the car that went on to win it, over the same laps. With 5 laps left, "podium, not the win" is the honest guess, and nobody gets to check.

cards.title: Lindblad: P22 on the grid, P10 at the flag
cards.text: 12 places gained.
bullets: 3 on-track passes along the way
3 cars that started ahead of him retired

cards.title: How far behind was Antonelli at the flag?
cards.text: 55 laps, 1 hour 47 minutes of racing. Put a number on the gap to the winner.
cards.reveal: 2.307 seconds after 55 laps. A trip down the pit lane took about 28s today, which is 12 times this gap.

cards.title: Verstappen: 1:38.220
cards.text: The quickest anybody went all race, in a Red Bull.
bullets: Set on lap 55 of 55, late on, where they usually land
By then the fuel is nearly gone and the car is at its lightest
It is worth no points: the bonus point for it was dropped after 2024

cards.title: Verstappen wins it
cards.text: P1 Verstappen · P2 Antonelli · P3 Hamilton.
bullets: After 55 laps, Antonelli crossed the line 2.307s behind
